title: Capital Gains Manual
summary:
HMRC is reviewing the CG Manual to ensure it provides
HMRC’s interpretation of relevant legislation where there is more than one
reasonable view of how rules work.Where material in the CG Manual isn’t
providing an interpretation, that material is being removed. Where appropriate,
material will be reproduced elsewhere and linked from the CG Manual.

title: Guaranteed minimum pension conversion provisions
summary: This technical consultation seeks comments on draft secondary legislation amending Finance Act 2004 for calculating pension input amounts for annual allowance purposes following guaranteed minimum pension conversion.

title: Guidance: External temporary storage facilities codes for Data Element 5/23 of the Customs Declaration Service
summary: Find the codes which can be used in Data Element 5/23 to identify the location where the goods may be examined for an external temporary storage facility (ETSF) (Appendix 16F).

title: Corporation Tax: terminal, capital and property income losses
summary: Guidance for companies to work out and claim relief from Corporation Tax on terminal losses, capital losses and property income losses.

title: Food products (VAT Notice 701/14)
summary: Find out which types of food are zero-rated and which are standard-rated for VAT purposes.

title: HMRC doubles funding for customers who need extra support
summary: £11 million in grant funding available to help customers who need extra support

title: Non-statutory Clearance Guidance
summary: This manual is for all HMRC staff dealing with Non-Statutory Clearances and set out how to deal with any NSC request.

title: Online services for agents
summary: Information about services available to agents, including Self Assessment and PAYE for agents online services, multi-factor authentication, calculators and the HMRC App. Find out about service availability and any current issues.

title: The Tax Agent's Handbook
summary: Information to help tax agents and advisers find guidance, use HMRC's services and contact HMRC.

title: Corporate Intangibles Research and Development Manual
summary: Corporation Tax and the taxation of intangible assets, remediation of contaminated land, vaccines research relief and tax credits for research & development.

title: Child Benefit Technical Manual
summary: A guide to the law relating to Child Benefit and Guardian's Allowance. It is presented in 12 main sections, which generally reflect the order of the relevant acts and regulations.

title: Catering, takeaway food (VAT Notice 709/1)
summary: Find out when and at what rate you need to charge VAT if you supply food and drink for catering or takeaway.

title: Advance Tax Certainty Service
summary: A guide to support both customers and HMRC colleagues with the operation of the Advance Tax Certainty Service.

title: Enquiry Manual
summary: How HM Revenue & Customs carries out tax enquiry work

title: Guidance: HMRC Grant Funding — application guidance
summary: Guidance for voluntary and community sector organisations on how to apply for HMRC's funding grant for 2027 to 2030.

title: Promotional material: Communications resources to help you move goods from Great Britain to Northern Ireland
summary: Information and resources to help businesses use the Windsor Framework changes for parcels and freight.

title: Guidance: Working for HMRC: information for applicants
summary: Information for people applying for, or thinking of applying for, roles at HM Revenue and Customs.

title: Economic Crime Supervision Handbook
summary: The aim of the ECS handbook is to give you clear and comprehensive guidance on how to undertake your role within ECS. It will help you understand the legislation, how our policies work and how they should be applied. It will also explain how to apply the sanctions framework and the powers available for you to use under the MLR2017. Additionally, it may be used by external customers to understand how sanctions are applied.

title: Guidance: Double Taxation Treaty Passport Scheme register
summary: Check the status of overseas corporate lenders who are passport holders for Double Taxation Relief on UK loan interest.

title: Guidance: Approved payers in the middleman scheme
summary: Check this list of approved payers for non-UK resident entertainers and find out if you need to deduct withholding tax.
